items.item: `Sources/Byte Channel/Byte.Channel.Gate.swift`: `reserve(_:)` traps with a precondition when a chu
items.reason: Gate.reserve throws .full (or the installed terminal error, if the direction already ended) for a chunk larger than capacity; Writer.send turns that into .rejected(chunk, .full). Test sends a 2-byte chunk through a capacity-1 pair.

notes: Gate.init's precondition(capacity != .zero) left as is: Gate is internal and only built by pair(capacity:) for nonzero capacity (zero goes to the rendezvous backend), so it is an internal invariant, not caller input; the issue does not list it.
